newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofgas to decide on Centrica plan soon.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofgas to decide on Centrica plan soon.

text.p: British natural gas industry regulator Ofgas hopes to give a decision this week on approve for Centrica's ValuePlus scheme, a spokesman said on Monday.

ValuePlus proposes an extra discount for domestic gas users who pay by direct debit and was launched in early March through BG Home Energy, the domestic market brand which is part of British Gas Trading (BGT).
Centrica is the arm of the demerged British Gas plc which has taken over its domestic supply functions.

ValuePlus is open to all customers in the south-western counties of Devon, Cornwall and Somerset -- the first area of Britain to be opened up to domestic competition in late April last year -- who pay by direct debit.
On joining they receive a discount of 12 percent on the standard tariff, compared to a six percent discount automatically offered to direct debit customers.

Ofgas has to consider whether or not competition has been established. Under the 1995 Gas Act, the monopoly supplier in a region can only lower prices to meet "established competition." Until then, it can only compete on such areas as service.
BGT says that 24 percent of direct debit customers have switched suppliers and now take their gas from competitors. This, argues BGT, shows that competition has been established.
A spokesman for Centrica said that ValuePlus was the company's response to the "aggressive" marketing by other suppliers.
Ofgas has consulted on the issue, and a spokesman said on Monday that they have now received over 80 submissions.

Sue Slipman, Director of the Gas Consumers Council, said at the time of the launch of ValuePlus that she had "some sympathy" with the BGT view that it was losing customers at an "unacceptable rate" in the South West. But she still expressed reservations over its introduction.

"In general we remain unconvinced that the regulator should accept that competition can be said to have been achieved, hence British Gas's price reduction could be judged as premature. We would certainly expect protest from other suppliers," she said.
